title: UI Dashboard
description: Per-golden view: verdict grid for skills and tools with stale badges, click-through to last-run details including diff, agent-manager run link, and metrics. Index page lists all goldens.

requirements.title: Verdict grid view
requirements.description: Per-golden page with two grids: (skill × verdict) and (tool × verdict). Cells show verdict icon + color + label. Stale tuples show a stale badge. Click a cell to open the detail panel.

validation.notes: Goldens index renders per-golden verdict-summary chips from report.getGoldenSummary.
Runs surface lists active runs with status and a start-run form.

requirements.title: Drill-down details panel
requirements.description: On cell click: show last validation record (verdict, timestamps, duration, tokens, cost, agent-manager run id with link if applicable), the active manifest, and the recorded diff (or tool output for tooling baselines).

validation.notes: Run drill-down renders status, terminal verdict, provenance (agent-manager run id), and error states.
Tuple-detail history/diff/manifest tabs and the run-validation affordance are reachable per the flow contract.
